mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates weakening consumer demand and labor market stress, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 690000.0 and UNRATE > 3.5, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 300.0 with a concurrent increase in the federal funds rate to 4.5% or higher signals a tightening monetary cycle aimed at controlling inflation, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both CPIAUCSL > 300.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 4.5, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.0% combined with a rise in non-farm payrolls above 200k signals a tight labor market that pressures firms to raise wages, increasing input costs and reducing profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 3.0 and PAYEMS > 200.0, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past four quarters, combined with a drop in residential construction (HOUST), indicates a weakening economic expansion, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 20200.0 AND HOUST < 1400.0 in t-4mo and t-2mo respectively
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 < 20200.0 and HOUST < 1400.0, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
